item.title: 5 Palestinians killed in Gaza as Israeli army continues strikes 1 year into ceasefire
item.description: Five Palestinians were killed and others wounded on Saturday in two Israeli airstrikes that targeted gatherings of Palestinian civilians in the Gaza Strip, Anadolu reports. The attacks come as Tel Aviv continues daily strikes despite a ceasefire that has been in effect since Oct. 10, 2025. Four Palestinians were killed and five others wounded in an Israeli drone strike targeting a gathering of people near Haidar Roundabout in western Gaza City, medical sources told Anadolu. Another Palestinian was killed, and others were wounded in an Israeli drone strike targeting a gathering of people in the Tuffah neighborhood in eastern Gaza City, the sources added. item.title: Netanyahu’s former aide alleges attempt to alter 7 October records
item.description:
Netanyahu’s former aide alleges attempt to alter 7 October records

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is facing renewed criticism over the 7 October 2023 Hamas-led attack and subsequent captive negotiations, Israeli media have reported. 

Netanyahu's former military secretary has accused him of prioritising his political survival over attempts to secure the captives' release.

Avi Gil, who served as Netanyahu's military secretary at the time of the attack and held the post until 2024, made the allegations in interviews with Israel's Channel 12 and daily Israel Hayom. 

Gil said Netanyahu had abandoned possible opportunities to secure the captives' return because an agreement threatened his governing coalition.

Some of those people later died in captivity.

Read more: Netanyahu’s former aide alleges attempt to alter 7 October records

item.title: French associations seek court order to halt shipment to Israeli arms company
item.description: Three French associations petitioned an administrative court in Paris on Friday to halt a shipment intended for Israeli defense firm Elbit Systems, citing France’s obligations under international law, Anadolu reports. The Franco-Palestinian association NIDAL, the human rights association ASER and JURDI (Jurists for Respect for International Law) said in a statement that they had petitioned the emergency judge at the Paris Administrative Court under the expedited procedure to protect fundamental freedoms. The associations said their legal action followed reports that Mijno Precision Gearing SAS, a company based in Saint-Etienne, had attempted to ship planetary gearboxes intended for military vehicles to Elbit Systems Land, the Israeli firm’s land systems division. item.title: Kremlin says Putin told Trump Iran's position on ending hostilities
item.description:
Kremlin says Putin told Trump Iran's position on ending hostilities

The Kremlin said on Saturday that Russian President Vladimir Putin had relayed Iran's position regarding a possible resolution to the US-Iran war to his US counterpart Donald Trump.

"In coordination with the president of Iran, Putin conveyed to Trump the Iranian side's view on a possible resolution of the conflict," Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov was quoted as saying by Russia's Interfax news agency.

Eight-year-old girl killed by Israeli gunfire in Gaza City
item.description:
Eight-year-old girl killed by Israeli gunfire in Gaza City

An eight-year-old Palestinian girl was killed by Israeli forces in Gaza City on Saturday, Wafa news reported.

Medical sources told Wafa that Shahd Abdul Razzaq al-Najjar was targeted by fire from an Israeli quadcopter drone in the al-Jawazat area of Gaza City.

Meanwhile, Wafa also reported that a woman was injured in Israeli fire in Khan Younis. 

One year into the so-called "ceasefire", more than 1,400 Palestinians have been killed in ongoing Israeli attacks on Gaza, according to the territory's health ministry.

item.title: Palestine welcomes Navi Pillay’s 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
item.description: Palestine on Friday welcomed South African jurist Navi Pillay’s being awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize, saying the honor recognizes her efforts to defend international law and document Israeli crimes, Anadolu reports. The Foreign Ministry said Pillay’s win represented an elevation of “the voice of truth and the voice of the oppressed,” and recognized her efforts to advance peace and international law. It said Pillay devoted her career to upholding law and justice and defending the rights of oppressed people in South Africa and around the world, including Palestinians. The ministry praised her leadership of the UN Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel, which she chaired from 2021 to 2025. item.title: Lebanon welcomes US decision to lift air travel restrictions
item.description: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun on Saturday welcomed US President Donald Trump’s decision to revoke executive orders restricting air travel between the US and Lebanon, Anadolu reports. The move reflects “confidence in the measures taken by the Lebanese state to ensure civil aviation safety, protect air traffic to and from Beirut, and enhance the security of flights connecting Lebanon with countries around the world,” the Lebanese Presidency said in a statement on US social media company X. Aoun also stressed Lebanon’s commitment to aviation safety in line with international standards to protect passengers and bolster confidence in its institutions, according to the statement.
